name: browserglass-plugin-permission-assist
description: Reference permission-assist plugin (docs/plugins.md): clicks Chrome's own "Allow remote debugging?" sheet via macOS AppleScript accessibility traversal, without foregrounding Chrome. A real, separate npm project, deliberately excluded from the root pnpm-workspace.yaml, the same way plugins/plugin-video-export and examples/nextjs-demo are: its @browserglass/plugin-api dependency points at file:../../packages/plugin-api, which resolves through that package's real exports map exactly the way an actual plugin author's npm install @browserglass/plugin-api would once it is published.
